points: Yirmiyahu points to the keilim of the Bais Hamikdash: they will be taken to Bavel and only returned 70 years later, under Persian rule (Rashi).
The people thought the Bais Hamikdash guaranteed their safety. Today too, the State of Israel is a huge gift, but we rely only on Hashem.
The Malbim: kings' ministers from Edom, Moav, Ammon, Tzor and Tzidon meet with Tzidkiyahu, then the military chief, to plan a revolt against Bavel.
Yirmiyahu shows up uninvited with yokes for each one: submit to Bavel and you'll be safe, rebel and you'll be in trouble.
Why does he care about other nations? Like Yonah in Ninveh, a navi cares about all of Hashem's creatures. We should care when other countries suffer too.
